data.title: Saria
data.about:
Saria by BEYOND is a stunning residential development in Dubai Maritime City, offering luxury waterfront living. Developed by Omniyat, this exclusive project features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exquisite 4-bedroom penthouses and duplexes. Each unit boasts floor-to-ceiling windows, ensuring natural light and offering spectacular views of the Marina and Arabian Gulf, making Saria Apartments for sale in Dubai an exceptional real estate opportunity.

Saria luxury living in Dubai Maritime City includes world-class amenities, such as an infinity swimming pool, a fully-equipped gym, and a serene wellness center with spa and steam rooms. Residents can enjoy beautifully landscaped gardens, a private cinema, and recreational spaces for a tranquil yet active lifestyle. With its strategic location and premium features, Saria by BEYOND is an ideal Dubai Maritime City investment opportunity.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Waterfront Location: Located in Dubai Maritime City, Saria by BEYOND offers residents stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and easy access to Dubai's top dining, shopping, and entertainment venues.
  • Luxury Residences: The development features a range of spacious 1-3 bedroom apartments and 4-bed duplexes and penthouses with modern finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and spectacular marina views.
  • Investment Opportunity: Purchasing Saria Apartments for Sale Dubai offers an exceptional investment opportunity with the added benefit of a residency visa with Saria investment.
  • Exclusive Lifestyle: With amenities like a private cinema, 7-km cycling trail, 5-km running track, and social spaces for gatherings, Saria luxury living in Dubai Maritime City offers a resort-like lifestyle that blends relaxation and luxury.

location_tile.title: Immerse Yourself in Breathtaking Views of the Sea, Marina, and City Skyline
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Saria by BEYOND is ideally located in Dubai Maritime City, offering residents a prime waterfront lifestyle. With stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, Saria luxury living combines the tranquility of coastal living with the convenience of easy access to Dubai's top dining, shopping, and entertainment venues. Its proximity to major city landmarks makes it a standout location for those seeking connectivity and luxury. Residents will also enjoy the serene environment of Dubai Maritime City, one of the city's newest super-yacht and sailing hubs.

  • Mina Rashid - 2 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai - 15 minutes
  • DIFC - 15 minutes
  • Public beach -10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 20 minutes.
